pairs.why: Both are squircle bodies with thin cables, but A's earbuds keep slim stems like the real ones, while B's buds are fatter and blobbier.
B's lid swings back at a shallower angle with a chunky curved end cap, closer to the real lid, though the two chests are nearly alike in form.
B keeps the real part count: no arms, a thin tube frame, and a straight strip back panel. A adds padded arms and a puffy contoured back.
B's sheets stay flat with straight edges and tight corners like the real stack. A's are wavy, rolled and soft-edged.
B has no armrests, a thin tube frame and a straight rectangular back strip, matching the real chair. A adds fat orange arms and a curved back.
Both are detailed locomotives with similar proportions, and the real cards give no clear silhouette reason to prefer one.
A's boot is compact and chunky with a wide shaft, in line with the simplified real objects. B's shaft is tall, thin and elongated.
B is a compact, chunky vehicle with a cab and big wheels, like the real taxi. A is a flat white box on spindly strut legs.
